The one-box save flow feels right, and having the newest link appear at the top is what I’d expect.

The automatic details are only partly what I had in mind. I’d want it to collect the page title, a short description, and the actual site icon; a preview image would also be useful when available. At a glance, the title, description, tags, and site icon matter most to me. The full URL can be less prominent.
